16 Month Internship

As a global technology leader, Celestica designs, engineers, and manufactures industry-leading products and services that drive customer success and market advancement. Headquartered in Toronto, Canada, we bring together over 33,000 employees across more than 45 sites in North America, Europe, and Asia.

With deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain management and platform solutions, Celestica enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances technologies in high-growth markets. Working with the world’s leading technology companies across a broad range of industries, Celestica helps its customers achieve a competitive advantage. These products span key areas such as data centre technology, aerospace and defense, healthtech, and capital equipment.

Working at Celestica is more than a job. It’s about being part of something bigger and shaping the future with your work. You’ll take on exciting and challenging projects, get hands-on experience, collaborate with a global team, and learn from some of the greatest minds in the industry. And just as we aspire to imagine, develop and deliver a better future with our customers, we’re just as committed to delivering the best employee experience.

Benefits For Students Include



- Experience working for one of the largest Canadian global technology companies
- Possibility of a student casual contract position after completion of internship
- Possibility of a full-time position after completion of degree
- Access to Celestica’s development programs and projects
- Celestica's Time Off to Volunteer program – two paid days off to volunteer per year
- Fun intern activities including celebration events and networking
- Internal recognition programs and rewards for stellar performance

What’s in it for you?



- Opportunity: Job experience at a large Canadian-based global company
- Innovation: We look to our employees to implement new ideas and improve the way we do things
- Collaboration: Students work as part of global teams, enabled by collaborative technology
- Sustainability: We uphold strong ethics, reduce our impact on the environment and empower employees to give back to the community with two paid days off per year to volunteer
- Development opportunities: including soft skills courses, innovation projects and mentorship
- Networking: Strategically build your professional network to advance your career and deepen relationships across your peers and colleagues. 
- Fun: Our interns have the opportunity to participate in fun activities including intern social events, Celestica’s charitable initiatives and our Spirit Week activities

About This Opportunity

The Salesforce Developer Intern will work with a team to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions across the Salesforce platform. The student will be involved in the configuration, development, and support of specific functionalities associated with Business Requirements from Operations/Business Counterparts. As well, they will provide ongoing support to end-users and resolve business issues through technological design and critical thinking.

Perferred Skills 



- 

- Enrolled in a formal University or college Internship program.
- Some degree of experience with Apex, Visualforce, and/or Lightning Web Components (LWC) (one or multiple). 
- Have some fundamental understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, object-oriented design, and relational databases. 
- Ability to adapt and adjust work accordingly in an evolving environment. 
- Basic knowledge of software development lifecycle concepts. 
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a solution-driven mindset. 
- Able to work with users around the globe and discern what their concerns/requirements are. 
Activities 



- 

- Design, develop, and implement solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and other platform tools to support business requirements on the Salesforce platform, working on key projects and initiatives. 
- Create and modify configurations using standard Salesforce tools, including Flow, and Validation Rules. 
- Troubleshoot production and test issues; performing root cause analysis, recommending corrective action, and performing resolution efforts. 
- Writing, testing, and debugging custom code and configurations, including Apex Classes, Apex Triggers, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Components (Aura/LWC). 
- Assuring quality, security, and compliance requirements are met for supported areas. 
- Provide ongoing support to end-users and resolve business issues through technological design and critical thinking. 
Physical Demands, duties of this position are varied and will include: 



- 

- Duties of this position are performed in a normal office with exposure to manufacturing environments.
- Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data
- Repetitive manual movements are frequently required (e.g. data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc).
- Basic manufacturing system knowledge.
Salary

The range described in this posting is an estimate by the Company, and may change based on several factors, including but not limited to a change in the duties covered by the job posting, or the credentials, experience or geographic jurisdiction of the successful candidate.

The hourly wage is determined by the years of study completed and is non-negotiable as per company policy.

Hourly Wage: $23-30 CAD/hr

Additional Details

Area: IT Enterprise Platform

Start Date: May 2027

Location: 5140 Yonge St, North York, ON M2N 6L7

Vacancies: 1 position

Experience: No formal experience required.

Education: Currently enrolled in an Undergraduate or Master's program in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or other related fields. Must be able to complete 16-month internship.

To apply, please visit www.celestica.com. Please provide a copy of your transcript with your application. Please include your student email address in your application.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws.

At Celestica we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. Special arrangements can be made for candidates who need it throughout the hiring process. Please indicate your needs and we will work with you to meet them.

Company Overview

Celestica (NYSE, TSX: CLS) enables the world’s best brands. Through our recognized customer-centric approach, we partner with leading companies in Aerospace and Defense, Communications, Enterprise, HealthTech, Industrial, Capital Equipment and Energy to deliver solutions for their most complex challenges. As a leader in design, manufacturing, hardware platform and supply chain solutions, Celestica brings global expertise and insight at every stage of product development – from drawing board to full-scale production and after-market services for products from advanced medical devices, to highly engineered aviation systems, to next-generation hardware platform solutions for the Cloud. Headquartered in Toronto, with talented teams spanning 40+ locations in 13 countries across the Americas, Europe and Asia, we imagine, develop and deliver a better future with our customers.

jd:
About Marvell

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

Your Team, Your Impact

The rapid growth of cloud computing, AI/ML, generative AI, 5G wireless, and high-performance data centers is driving unprecedented demand for higher bandwidth, lower power consumption, and efficient connectivity solutions. Marvell delivers industry-leading semiconductor technologies, including high-speed optical interconnects and transceivers, that power next-generation cloud, enterprise, and networking infrastructure.

Our team leverages large language models (LLMs), agentic AI, machine learning, and cloud-based data platforms to improve hardware testing, debugging, and performance optimization through intelligent automation and data-driven engineering.

What You Can Expect



- Design and develop scalable AI infrastructure, cloud-based data pipelines, and backend services to support engineering applications.
- Build and integrate LLM-powered applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and multi-agent AI frameworks for intelligent hardware testing, debugging, and automation.
- Develop AI-driven test harnesses to automate test execution, evaluate AI agent performance, and validate system reliability.
- Integrate AI agents with engineering tools, databases, APIs, and hardware test environments to enable autonomous workflows.
- Collaborate with AI, software, and hardware engineers to improve system performance, scalability, and reliability.
- Gain hands-on experience building production-oriented AI solutions that address real-world semiconductor engineering challenges.
- Work with emerging technologies in generative AI, cloud computing, and intelligent automation while contributing to impactful engineering projects.

Minimum Qualifications

What We're Looking For



- Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, with an anticipated graduation date between Fall 2027 and Spring 2028.
- Proficiency in Python and familiarity with software development fundamentals.
- Foundational understanding of AI/ML, LLMs, or generative AI technologies.
- Familiarity with databases, APIs, and data processing workflows.
- Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

Preferred Qualifications



- Experience with LLM APIs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, or agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or CrewAI.
- Familiarity with multi-agent architectures, AI agent evaluation, automated test harnesses, or AI workflow orchestration.
- Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure and data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks.
- Familiarity with backend development, REST APIs, Docker, or CI/CD pipelines.
- Experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn.
- Knowledge of DSP, semiconductor hardware, connectivity systems, or hardware validation is a plus but not required.

Expected Base Pay Range (USD)

34 - 68, $ per hour.

The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.

Additional Compensation And Benefit Elements

Marvell is committed to providing exceptional, comprehensive benefits that support our employees at every stage - from internship to retirement and through life’s most important moments. Our offerings are built around four key pillars: financial well-being, family support, mental and physical health, and recognition. Highlights for our interns: medical, dental, and vision coverage, perks and discounts, robust mental health resources to prioritize emotional well-being, and paid holidays. Additional compensation may be available for intern PhD candidates. We look forward to sharing more with you during the interview process.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

Any applicant who requires a reasonable accommodation during the selection process should contact Marvell HR Helpdesk at TAOps@marvell.com.

Interview Integrity 

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.

This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description

Role Overview

Join the AI Enablement team within HPE Labs to turn promising AI research and prototypes into dependable, reusable capabilities for enterprise adoption. Work at the intersection of AI innovation, engineering, and business impact.

We're looking for Master's and PhD students who are curious researchers and hands-on builders, eager to investigate hard problems, code, experiment, learn from experienced teams, and create tangible impact.

What You'll Do



- Solve real business problems. Explore emerging AI technologies against business challenges, user needs, and opportunities for impact.
- Research, experiment, and build. Turn promising approaches into working solutions using LLMs, generative AI, agentic systems, machine learning, and other emerging technologies.
- Go beyond prototypes. Help prepare solutions for real-world use, addressing integration, evaluation, guardrails, security, reliability, and operational requirements.
- Explore the AI lifecycle. Gain hands-on experience in problem framing, experimentation, solution design, evaluation, implementation, and operationalization.
- Build for reuse. Create components, tools, reference implementations, and patterns that accelerate future AI initiatives.
- Collaborate across disciplines. Work with researchers, AI and software engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders to connect technical decisions to business outcomes.
- Share what you learn. Explain approaches, findings, tradeoffs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
- Contribute to innovation. Depending on the project and results, contribute to intellectual property, publications, open-source projects, or other knowledge sharing.

Who We're Looking For

Graduate students who learn deeply, build quickly, and bring curiosity, strong technical fundamentals, and a drive to turn ideas into working solutions. You don't need to know everything before you start.

Education & Experience



- Pursuing a Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical or quantitative field.
- Applied AI/ML or software engineering experience through coursework, research, projects, open-source contributions, internships, or professional work.
- Experience building AI/ML applications, systems, or prototypes, ideally shown through meaningful projects or GitHub/open-source work.
- We value candidates who combine research with hands-on building, and who can evaluate and explain what they built. Publications are welcome, not required.

Knowledge & Skills



- Strong fundamentals in AI/ML, data science, or software engineering.
- Familiarity with the current AI landscape, including LLMs, generative AI, agentic AI, and related tools and frameworks. Deep expertise is a plus, not a requirement.
- Python proficiency and experience with relevant AI/ML frameworks and development tools.
- Ability to design experiments, analyze results, and iterate toward working solutions.
- Interest in moving AI experiments toward production-quality capabilities.
- Familiarity with, or eagerness to learn, AI evaluation, responsible AI, guardrails, security, and data privacy.
- Strong problem-solving skills and curiosity about how technology works and why it matters.
- Clear communication and effective collaboration across technical and business backgrounds.
- A builder mindset: make things work, learn from setbacks, and iterate.

What You'll Get From The Experience

Learn how promising AI ideas move from research to production. Work on real initiatives with researchers and engineers, from problem framing and experimentation through building, evaluation, and preparation for broader adoption.

Deliver a well-researched, reusable, and evaluated solution that the team can continue building on. Connect technical work to business value, learn how enterprise AI works in practice, and leave behind work others can use and extend.

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

What We Can Offer You

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Let's Stay Connected

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

About Us

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.

What You'll Do

As a Business Support System Software Developer Intern, you'll work on developing a next generation business support system to enable Viasat to sell cutting edge products across a wide variety of industries around the world. We're using the latest AI tools to allow product owners to rapidly and efficiently create new products to sell to customers and support their experience with us.

The day-to-day



- Work on variety of BSS and OSS including cutting edge cloud native platforms to full stack web services development.
- Support software design teams, business stakeholders, and test teams, getting hands-on experience solving problems, building, operating and validating software components for Viasat.
- Develop, test, and deploy software applications.
- Implement automation solutions to streamline workflows and reduce manual efforts.
- Participate in code reviews and regular team meetings.
- Collaborate with other developers and product managers.
- Support the addition of new features to internal tools.
- Troubleshoot and resolve issues to maintain a high performing product.


Internship Program Details



- Viasat’s internship program is site-based. Site‑based employees work 3+ days (60%+) per week from a Viasat office or work location within a standard five‑day work week. Viasat embraces a flexible work environment and onsite/hybrid work is determined by individual roles and teams.
- To ensure equity across our intern population, intern compensation is pre-determined based on a variety of factors including role, location, and degree level. Intern compensation is non-negotiable.
- Housing assistance is available pending eligibility. 


What You'll Need



- Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree or higher in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. To be eligible for this position, your final graduation date must fall between December 2027 and August 2028.
- Internship Dates: You must be available to work 40 hours/week for the full duration of the internship program. Limited exceptions may be granted. Viasat offers two cohort options based on semester and quarter academic calendars:

- Cohort 1: May 17, 2027 – August 6, 2027
- Cohort 2: June 21, 2027 – September 10, 2027
- Citizenship: This position requires a valid Work Permit or Visa for the country you would be located and working from.
- Additional:

- Demonstrated interest in generative AI and AI-assisted software development through coursework, projects, or research. Experience using Claude or similar AI development tools is a plus.
- Experience developing in and deploying to cloud platforms such as AWS.
- Familiarity developing ServiceNow products.
- Strong familiarity with creating efficient and robust software in languages such as Python, C++, Java.


What Will Help You On The Job



- Coursework or experience in designing, writing, and testing software in at least one of the following domains: embedded systems, networking, communications, web services/full stack, data & analytics.
- Prior experience with modern software engineering tools and processes such as GitHub, Jira, K8s, Agile/Scrum, CI/CD, DevOps.
- Excellent oral and written communication skills.
- Ability to work autonomously and as part of a team.


 Salary range

$20.91 - $56.97 / hourly. For specific work locations within San Jose, the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, the base pay range for this role is $25.96 - $67.07/ hourly

At Viasat, we consider many factors when it comes to compensation, including the scope of the position as well as your background and experience. Additional cash or stock incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. What You'll Do:
• Put robots to work . Get quadrupeds, drones and test rigs inspecting, scanning and measuring P3 hardware in the lab and in the field.
• Give them a brain . Connect robots to vision models, LLMs and Exowatt's in-house agent stack so they can plan and act on their own.
• Sim first, then real . Rehearse tasks in simulation (Isaac Sim, MuJoCo), then make them work on hardware and compare what the sim predicted with what happened.
• Build the glue . Sensors, firmware, mounts you print or machine yourself, and the software that turns a robot run into data the engineering team uses.
• Build with AI . Use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and our internal tools) daily to move fast, and help the rest of Exowatt learn to do the same.
• Own a project . Write your own plan with your mentor, ship it, and demo the result to Software leadership in April.

What You'll Bring:
• Currently pursuing a degree in computer science, robotics, mechanical, electrical or computer engineering, or a related field.
• Available to work on site in Miami, FL from January 12 to April 16, 2027.
• Hands-on robotics experience: you've built, wired or programmed a robot that actually ran.
• Comfort with both hardware and software: code (Python, C++ or similar) plus some CAD, electronics or fabrication.
• You love AI. You already build with AI coding tools and have opinions about which ones work.
• A builder's mindset: you ship rough versions early, break things, and fix them.

Nice to Have:
• FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) experience is strongly encouraged . FTC, VEX or a college robotics team counts too. Tell us your team number.
• ROS 2, WPILib, computer vision (OpenCV, YOLO), SLAM or path planning.
• Drones (PX4/ArduPilot) or legged robots (e.g. Unitree).
• 3D printing, PCB design, or machine shop experience.
• Experience with simulation (Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Gazebo) or training/finetuning models.
• A side project you're proud of. Send us one link: a repo, a video, or a CAD model.
• Interest in energy, solar or hardware at scale.

 Date: Nov 17, 2026

 Location: 

 Denton, TX, US, 76205-7864

 Company: 
 PACCAR 

 Company Information
 
 PACCAR is a global technology leader in the design, manufacture and customer support of high-quality light-, medium- and heavy-duty trucks under the Kenworth, Peterbilt and DAF nameplates. PACCAR also designs and manufactures advanced power trains, provides financial services and information technology, and distributes truck parts related to its principal business. 

 Peterbilt Motors Company 

On highways, construction sites, city streets, logging roads - everywhere our customers earn their living - Peterbilt's red oval is a familiar symbol of performance, reliability and pride. Peterbilt has reigned as America's premium quality truck manufacturer since the company's founding in 1939. Our dedication to deliver products and services focused on improving customers' performance, image, profitability and peace of mind truly makes Peterbilt the Class of the Industry. 

 Requisition Summary
 
 Peterbilt Motors Company, a PACCAR Company, has an internship for students currently enrolled in college. This opening is for a Data Scientist Intern to add to our Advanced Analytics team in Denton, Texas.  

 Job Responsibilities
 
 This position will be working on various projects and reports to include but not limited to: 

• Write complex SQL queries, including joins, aggregations, common table expressions, and window functions, to prepare and analyze data. 

• Develop scalable data science solutions, from exploratory analysis, hypothesis testing, and feature engineering through model development, validation, deployment, and monitoring. 

• Apply machine learning, statistical methods, decision models, and Generative AI  methodologies to transform data into actionable business insights. 

• Collaborate with senior team members to understand business needs, translate those needs into analytical problems, and communicate updates and results clearly. 

• Develop Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows using embeddings, vector databases, and build harness engineered LLM workflows under the guidance of senior team members. 

• Build, test, deploy, and monitor AI solutions using cloud platforms and managed services such as AWS Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform (previously Vertex AI), or Azure AI Foundry. 

• Use GitHub for version control and team collaboration and apply Markdown-Driven Development (MDD) best practices to agent-assisted solution development. 

• Document methodologies, assumptions, designs, test results, and operational procedures while following responsible AI, privacy, security, and model governance standards. 

 Required Qualifications
 
 The candidate we seek will currently be enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree program in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related quantitative program. 

 The candidate should also have: 

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills. 

• Python Programming experience and its data science ecosystem (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, plotly, numpy, scipy), including modular development, object-oriented programming, testing, exception handling, and logging. 

• Working knowledge of SQL, including the ability to develop queries using joins, aggregations, and window functions. 

• Good Knowledge of Machine Learning, statistical analysis, LLMs and Data Science concepts. 

• Experience developing solutions using one or more cloud platforms, such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Microsoft Azure. 

• Experience analyzing data, evaluating results, and communicating findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

• Ability to work collaboratively with team members and stakeholders in a project-based environment. 

• Understanding of responsible AI principles, including privacy, security, bias, explainability, and model governance. 

 Preferred Qualifications 
 
 The qualifications that are important to be successful in this position are as follows: 

• Experience working with Snowflake and writing SQL for data preparation and analysis. 

• Experience using Git-based development workflows, including branching, pull requests, and release management. 

• Familiarity with Large Language Models, Decision Models, prompt engineering, embedding, tool-calling workflows, and multi-step agents both using open source (Langgraph) and managed cloud AI services. 

• Experience using managed Generative AI services, such as AWS Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform (previously Vertex AI), or Azure AI Foundry. 

• Design solution architectures for machine learning, RAG, and agent-based applications, including model selection, retrieval strategy, orchestration, evaluation, observability, version control, testing, and production monitoring. 

• Experience developing Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions using a vector database, such as pgvector, Pinecone, or an equivalent platform. 

• Familiarity with MLOps practices, including version control (Git), and experiment tracking (MLflow, OpenTelemetry, Arize Phoenix, or similar). 

• Design and execute experiments, including A/B tests and hypothesis tests, and translate findings into clear business recommendations. 

 General Description of Internship Benefits
 
 As a U.S. PACCAR intern, you have a full range of benefit options including: 

• Competitive salary and 401k with up to a 5% company match 

• Medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family 

• Paid holidays 

• Flexible spending accounts (FSA) and health savings account (HSA) 

• Life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance 

• EAP services including wellness plans, estate planning, financial counseling and more 

• Global Fortune 500 company with a wide array of growth, training, and development opportunities 

• Work alongside experienced goal-oriented colleagues recognized as experts in their field 

• This position may offer stipend assistance benefits 

 Additional Job Board Information
 
 PACCAR is an E-Verify & Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veteran/Disability corporation. Peterbilt promotes Diversity and Inclusion through mentorship, events, and affinity support groups – The Diversity Council, Peterbilt Women’s Initiative (PBWIN), Veterans Group, Peterbilt Black Organization for Leadership and Development (B.O.L.D) and Peterbilt+ (An LGBTQ support group).

Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. Building on the smartphone foundation and the scale of mobile, Qualcomm envisions making AI ubiquitous - expanding beyond mobile and powering other end devices, machines, vehicles, and things. We are inventing, developing, and commercializing power-efficient on-device AI, edge cloud AI, and 5G to make this a reality.

The AI Processor System software team is looking for talented and passionate engineers to develop and deliver novel embedded AI solutions to enable state-of-the-art AI models on auto platforms for millions of end users.

 * Python
